x.C_Invoice_ID ELSE x.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID + 1000000000 END, x.AD_Client_ID, x.AD_Org_ID, x.IsActive, x.C_Invoice_ID, x.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID, x.DocumentNo, x.POReference, x.Description, x.IsSOTrx, x.DocStatus, x.C_DocType_ID, x.DocBaseType, x.C_Order_ID, x.C_BPartner_ID, x.C_BPartner_Location_ID, x.AD_User_ID, x.C_BP_Group_ID, x.C_BP_AccountType_ID, x.C_BP_SalesGroup_ID, x.DiscountDate, x.NetDays, x.DaysDue, x.C_Currency_ID, x.C_ConversionType_ID, x.PaymentRule, x.C_PaymentTerm_ID, x.IsPayScheduleValid, x.InvoiceCollectionType, x.IsInDispute, x.GrandTotal, x.DiscountAmt, x.PaidAmt, x.OpenAmt FROM ( SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.Raw > -y.Eps AND y.Raw < y.Eps THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(y.Raw, 0), CAST(y.Prec AS INTEGER)) END AS OpenAmt FROM ( SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN b.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID IS NULL THEN b.SignedTotal - b.MultAP * b.PaidRaw ELSE CASE WHEN b.DueAmt - GREATEST(0, b.MultAP * b.PaidRaw - b.CumDueBefore) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE b.DueAmt * b.MultCM - GREATEST(0, b.MultAP * b.PaidRaw - b.CumDueBefore) END END AS Raw FROM ( SELECT i.AD_Client_ID, i.AD_Org_ID, i.IsActive, i.C_Invoice_ID, i.DocumentNo, i.POReference, i.Description, i.IsSOTrx, i.DocStatus, i.C_DocType_ID, d.DocBaseType, i.C_Order_ID, i.C_BPartner_ID, i.C_BPartner_Location_ID, i.AD_User_ID, bp.C_BP_Group_ID, bp.C_BP_AccountType_ID, bp.C_BP_SalesGroup_ID, bp.C_BP_Segment_ID, PaidRaw, 1 / POWER(10, cur.StdPrecision) AS Eps, cur.StdPrecision AS Prec, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS DueAmt, CAST(0 AS NUMERIC) AS CumDueBefore, p.NetDays, CASE WHEN p.IsDueFixed = 'Y' THEN paymenttermduedate(i.C_PaymentTerm_ID, i.DateInvoiced::timestamptz) ELSE CAST(i.DateInvoiced AS DATE) + CAST(p.NetDays AS INTEGER) END AS DueDate, CASE WHEN p.IsDueFixed = 'Y' THEN paymenttermduedays(i.C_PaymentTerm_ID, i.DateInvoiced::timestamptz, now()) ELSE CAST(now() AS DATE) - (CAST(i.DateInvoiced AS DATE) + CAST(p.NetDays AS INTEGER)) END AS DaysDue, CAST(i.DateInvoiced AS DATE) + CAST(p.DiscountDays AS INTEGER) AS DiscountDate, ROUND(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(d.DocBaseType, 3, 1) = 'C' THEN i.GrandTotal * -1 ELSE i.GrandTotal END * p.Discount / 100, 2) AS DiscountAmt, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(d.DocBaseType, 3, 1) = 'C' THEN i.GrandTotal * -1 ELSE i.GrandTotal END AS GrandTotal, ROUND(COALESCE(al.Paid, 0), 2) AS PaidAmt FROM C_Invoice i INNER JOIN C_DocType d ON (d.C_DocType_ID = i.C_DocType_ID) INNER JOIN C_BPartner bp ON (bp.C_BPartner_ID = i.C_BPartner_ID) INNER JOIN C_BPartner_Location bpl ON (bpl.C_BPartner_Location_ID = (cur.C_Currency_ID = i.C_Currency_ID) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN h.C_Currency_ID = i.C_Currency_ID THEN line.Amount + line.DiscountAmt + line.WriteOffAmt ELSE currencyConvert(line.Amount + line.DiscountAmt + line.WriteOffAmt, h.C_Currency_ID, i.C_Currency_ID, h.DateTrx, NULL, h.AD_Client_ID, h.AD_Org_ID) END) AS Paid FROM C_AllocationLine line INNER JOIN C_AllocationHdr h ON (h.C_AllocationHdr_ID = line.C_AllocationHdr_ID) WHERE line.C_Invoice_ID = i.C_Invoice_ID AND h.DocStatus IN ('CO', 'CL') ) al ON TRUE WHERE i.DocStatus IN ('CO', 'CL') AND i.IsPayScheduleValid <> 'Y' -- Exclude document types flagged as excluded from invoice report AND COALESCE(d.IsExcludeFromInvoiceReport,'N') <> 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT i.AD_Client_ID, i.AD_Org_ID, i.IsActive, i.C_Invoice_ID, i.DocumentNo, i.POReference, i.Description, i.IsSOTrx, i.DocStatus, i.C_DocType_ID, d.DocBaseType, i.C_Order_ID, i.C_BPartner_ID, i.C_BPartner_Location_ID, i.AD_User_ID, bp.C_BP_Group_ID, bp.C_BP_AccountType_ID, bp.C_BP_SalesGroup_ID, bp.C_BP_Segment_ID, bp.C_BP_IndustryType_ID, i.SalesRep_ID, i.C_SalesRegion_ID, i.AD_OrgTrx_ID, i.C_Campaign_ID, i.C_Project_ID, i.C_Activity_ID, i.M_PriceList_ID, i.DateInvoiced, i.DateAcct, i.C_Currency_ID, i.C_ConversionType_ID, i.PaymentRule, i.C_PaymentTerm_ID, i.IsPayScheduleValid, i.InvoiceCollectionType, i.IsInDispute, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(d.DocBaseType, 3, 1) = 'C' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(d.DocBaseType, 2, 1) = 'P' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC), COALESCE(al.Paid, 0), 1 / POWER(10, cur.StdPrecision), cur.StdPrecision, ips.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID, ips.DueAmt, COALESCE(cum.DueBefore, 0), CAST(ips.DueDate AS DATE) - CAST(i.DateInvoiced AS DATE), ips.DueDate, CAST(CURRENT_DATE AS DATE) - CAST(ips.DueDate AS DATE), ips.DiscountDate, ips.DiscountAmt, ips.DueAmt, ROUND(COALESCE(al.Paid, 0), 2) FROM C_Invoice i INNER JOIN C_DocType d ON (d.C_DocType_ID = i.C_DocType_ID) INNER JOIN C_BPartner bp ON (bp.C_BPartner_ID = i.C_BPartner_ID) INNER JOIN C_BPartner_Location bpl ON (bpl.C_BPartner_Location_ID = i.C_BPartner_Location_ID) INNER JOIN C_Location loc ON (loc.C_Location_ID = bpl.C_Location_ID) INNER JOIN C_Currency cur ON (cur.C_Currency_ID = i.C_Currency_ID) INNER JOIN C_InvoicePaySchedule ips ON (ips.C_Invoice_ID = i.C_Invoice_ID AND ips.IsValid = 'Y') LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(prev.DueAmt) AS DueBefore FROM C_InvoicePaySchedule prev WHERE prev.C_Invoice_ID = ips.C_Invoice_ID AND prev.IsValid = 'Y' AND (prev.DueDate < ips.DueDate OR (prev.DueDate = ips.DueDate AND prev.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID < ips.C_InvoicePaySchedule_ID)) ) cum ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN h.C_Currency_ID = i.C_Currency_ID THEN line.Amount + line.DiscountAmt + line.WriteOffAmt ELSE currencyConvert(line.Amount + line.DiscountAmt + line.WriteOffAmt, h.C_Currency_ID, i.C_Currency_ID, h.DateTrx, NULL, h.AD_Client_ID, h.AD_Org_ID) END) AS Paid FROM C_AllocationLine line INNER JOIN C_AllocationHdr h ON (h.C_AllocationHdr_ID = line.C_AllocationHdr_ID) WHERE line.C_Invoice_ID = i.C_Invoice_ID AND h.DocStatus IN ('CO', 'CL') ) al ON TRUE WHERE i.DocStatus IN ('CO', 'CL') AND i.IsPayScheduleValid = 'Y' -- Exclude document types flagged as excluded from invoice report AND COALESCE(d.IsExcludeFromInvoiceReport,'N') <> 'Y' ) b ) y ) x WHERE x.OpenAmt <> 0;
